title: Lift one teardown helper out of perform_cleanup and stop unregister orphaning its workspace record
action: Decisions D3 and D3a. perform_cleanup performs FIVE removal steps, not four: git worktree remove --force (merge.rs:307), git branch -d (merge.rs:318, NEVER -D), grant drop (merge.rs:334), ws::unregister_workspace (merge.rs:341), release_all_for_holder (merge.rs:342). Lift those side effects into ONE helper. Two hard constraints: (1) directory removal is an EXPLICIT non-default parameter of the helper, and the helper asserts std::env::current_dir() is not inside the root it is about to remove -- that assertion is the guard against a future caller self-deleting; (2) the serde_json Map construction STAYS in perform_cleanup -- move only the side-effect calls. Constraint 2 is what keeps wr-0's key-order pins green; a helper returning a Result funnelled through one uniform formatter collapses the dirty and branch-delete-failed shapes and loses `removed: true` from its middle slot. Then wire run_unregister (registry.rs:218) to the REGISTRY HALF only -- grant, workspace record, holds release -- never the directory. run_unregister defaults --id to the CURRENT worktree when run from inside one (registry.rs:238) and, unlike run_merge (handlers.rs:427), carries no ordinary-checkout refusal, so a directory-capable path there would recreate exactly the self-delete run_merge exists to prevent. Lock nesting is already precedented: unregister_workspace takes its own workspace:<id> lock (workspace_store.rs:415) and already runs nested under WORKTREE_ADMIN_LOCK on the merge path (phases.rs:469).

truths: bee worktree unregister leaves no .bee/runtime/workspaces/<id>.json behind
bee worktree unregister run from inside a worktree removes no directory
wr-0's three pins and tests.rs:217 and tests.rs:228 stay green with no edit to their assertions
artifacts: A test that registers then unregisters a worktree and asserts both the grant entry and the workspace record are gone
A test that the teardown helper refuses to remove a directory containing the current working directory
prohibitions: Never git branch -D, anywhere, for any reason
Do not change any cleanup outcome shape's key order
Do not give directory removal a default value

trace.outcome: Lifted perform_cleanup's five teardown steps into one teardown_worktree helper with a directory-removal guard; run_unregister now wires to its registry half and no longer orphans workspace records
